lab_distinct.evidence: Checked for obsvs: see-vs-guess sort + jar drops + claim/evidence; not flagask (questions) or flaghuh (confusion feeling).

predictions.evidence: Checked for obsvs: tempting wrongs on melting=interp, drops=sad, angry=observation, proud as evidence, jealous leaf.

readability.evidence: Checked for obsvs: ages 6–7 kid lines see/hear/guess/measure; adult names observation vs interpretation within FK bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked for obsvs: sentences only define the split, name a slip, or describe a lab move — no delve/journey filler.
